alternative.port: Only nested VALUE-expression braces and .ic syntax changed for LTspice. LTspice then clamped the vendor ideal-diode N parameters to 0.1.

baseline.status: Simplified research fixture completed; does not represent the Flamingo PCB.
baseline.conclusion: Nominal results use most of the voltage allowance before static tolerances. This fixture does not establish a replacement design.

alternative.detailedCandidates: The distributed-bank and faster-inductor candidates stopped with time-step errors before reaching their load changes. These are simulator failures, not evidence of hardware failure.
